yuki.text: I found Yuki near [color=#F6416C][url=bruce_hall_grassland]Bruce Hall grassland[/url][/color] today. A small white dog with a red collar turned an ordinary walk into the warmest little campus mystery. If you are around in the afternoon, keep an eye out for the bell on her collar.

bruce_hall_grassland.text: A small white dog with a red collar is often seen around the Bruce Hall grassland in the afternoon.

chess_board.text: The strange thumping near [color=#F6416C][url=library_chessboard]the library[/url][/color] led me to the giant chess board. The pieces are huge, quiet, and almost ceremonial, like the campus has been hiding a puzzle in plain sight.

library_chessboard.text: A rhythmic thumping sound near the library might point toward the giant chess board.

kangaroo.text: I really did see a kangaroo near [color=#F6416C][url=sports_field_fence]the sports field fence[/url][/color]. It paused for a second, looked right at me, then slipped back toward Black Mountain Park. ANU still has surprises tucked between ordinary paths.

sports_field_fence.text: Something unusual was spotted near the sports field fence, close to the edge of Black Mountain Park.

student_accommodation_basketball_court.text: Joined a quick game at [color=#F6416C][url=student_accommodation_basketball_court]the Student Accommodation basketball court[/url][/color]. It started as one missing player and turned into names, passes, and a tiny first-week team.
A half-court near Student Accommodation can turn an awkward first meeting into a small team.

wamburun_ursula_free_food.text: Found the real route behind [color=#F6416C][url=anusa_food_support]ANUSA food support[/url][/color]: free breakfast, Student Bites, food recovery, grocery vouchers, and people making sure help is visible before someone skips a meal.

anusa_food_support.text: ANUSA food support points students toward BKSS, Student Bites, food recovery, grocery vouchers, and other support options.

wamburun_ursula_duck_drive_slow_sign.text: Paused at [color=#F6416C][url=duck_drive_slow_sign]the duck drive slow sign[/url][/color] between Wamburun and Ursula. It looked cute at first, then became a tiny rule for sharing campus paths with smaller feet.

duck_drive_slow_sign.text: The duck drive slow sign near Wamburun and Ursula reminds students to slow down for animals crossing the path.

bruce_hall_lemon_tree.text: Followed a sticky-note rumour at [color=#F6416C][url=bruce_hall_lemon_tree]Bruce Hall[/url][/color] and found Lemon Tree. The treasure was not only a plant, but the reminder not to let someone look for hope alone.
A Bruce Hall rumour points toward a small sign of hope in the roof-top garden.

central_studying_area_board_games_societ.text: The invitation at [color=#F6416C][url=board_games_society]Board Games Society[/url][/color] was worth following. One table, one rules explanation, and suddenly the study break had room for new people.

board_games_society.text: A Friday game night invitation can lead stressed students out of study mode and into a welcoming table.

csit_engn_escape_room.text: Solved the trail to [color=#F6416C][url=csit_escape_room]the CSIT escape room[/url][/color]. The lock was less important than the moment everyone stopped rushing and started thinking together.

csit_escape_room.text: A puzzle room near CSIT rewards clear teamwork more than frantic guessing.

anu_sport_north_oval_anu_sport.text: Found [color=#F6416C][url=anu_sport_north_oval]ANU Sport[/url][/color] through North Oval. The treasure was learning that campus sport has more than one way in, even if you are not already on a team.

anu_sport_north_oval.text: North Oval can point students toward ANU Sport, casual activity, and ways into campus movement.

chifley_marie_reay_chifley_library.text: Mapped a quiet path through [color=#F6416C][url=chifley_library]Chifley Library[/url][/color]. The notebook clue made the shelves feel less like a maze and more like a place that can answer back.

chifley_library.text: A notebook map near Chifley Library helps turn shelves and study habits into a navigable campus clue.

copland_subway.text: Found the lunch route from [color=#F6416C][url=copland_subway_route]Copland to Subway[/url][/color]. It turns out a good campus shortcut can rescue more than just your timetable.

copland_subway_route.text: The route from Copland toward Subway can turn a busy campus day into something manageable.

southwest_aboriginal_land_management.text: Spent time with [color=#F6416C][url=aboriginal_land_management]Aboriginal Land Management[/url][/color] in the Southwest area. The treasure was learning to read the campus landscape with more care.

aboriginal_land_management.text: The Southwest landscape can point toward Aboriginal land management knowledge and careful attention to Country.

houses_canberra_traditional_bus_stop.text: Looked twice at [color=#F6416C][url=canberra_bus_stop]the Canberra traditional bus stop[/url][/color] near Houses. A place for waiting became a small lesson in campus design.

canberra_bus_stop.text: A concrete bus stop near Houses carries a small piece of Canberra design language.

houses_spiral_floor_tile.text: Found [color=#F6416C][url=spiral_floor_tile]the spiral floor tile[/url][/color] near Houses. The clue was underfoot the whole time, waiting for someone to stop walking automatically.

spiral_floor_tile.text: A spiral floor tile near Houses rewards students who slow down and look at the ground.

blocks_metal_frames_sculpture_six_fixed.text: Walked around [color=#F6416C][url=metal_frames_sculpture]the metal frames sculpture[/url][/color] until the angles finally made sense. This one only becomes clear when you move.

metal_frames_sculpture.text: The metal frames sculpture near Blocks changes meaning as the viewer changes position.

southwest_winged_harvest.text: Found [color=#F6416C][url=winged_harvest]Winged Harvest[/url][/color] in Southwest and took the slow route through its notes. Some campus treasures ask for respect before interpretation.

winged_harvest.text: Winged Harvest is an artwork whose materials and references ask for careful, respectful reading.

central_dragon_art_installation.text: Looked up inside [color=#F6416C][url=central_dragon]Central[/url][/color] and found the dragon art installation. The building had a sky after all.

central_dragon.text: A suspended dragon inside Central rewards players who remember to look above the usual line of sight.

fellows_oval_game_on.text: After Fellows Oval, [color=#F6416C][url=game_on_joplin_lane]Game On[/url][/color] kept the team energy going without another scoreboard. Turns out cooldown can still feel like play.

game_on_joplin_lane.text: Game On in Joplin Lane gives students a casual arcade space after sport or study.

art_and_music_cafe_on_4th_floor.text: Found [color=#F6416C][url=cafe_on_4th_floor]Cafe on 4th Floor[/url][/color] inside Art and Music. It is the kind of pause that makes rehearsal, coffee, and the next performance fit into one day.

cafe_on_4th_floor.text: The fourth-floor cafe in Art and Music works as a quiet pause between practice, performance, and campus life.

copland_event_notice_board.text: Decoded [color=#F6416C][url=copland_notice_board]the Copland event notice board[/url][/color]. Once the date, place, and host are clear, the wall stops being noise and starts becoming doors.

copland_notice_board.text: The Copland notice board helps students turn crowded event flyers into real campus invitations.

medical_physics_school_anatomical_model.text: Checked the lit window at [color=#F6416C][url=medical_physics_anatomical_model]Medical and Physics[/url][/color] and found the anatomical model. The shape was scary until we gave it a careful name.

medical_physics_anatomical_model.text: A lit window at the Medical and Physics School can turn an anatomical teaching model into an eerie night silhouette.
